purpose: Exhaustive source ownership inventory. Active Rust/WASM entries identify the live policy boundary; pending entries identify remaining JavaScript policy rather than disguising it as host glue. Historical native-candidate proof and installed activation remain separate from source ownership.

candidateEvidence.browserBoundary: Rust/WASM owns the active browser-policy boundaries recorded below; JavaScript retains browser/DOM effects, persistence handles, listeners, rendering, and third-party engines. This source inventory does not certify installed activation or real-Chrome E2E.

frozenSelectorOracle.role: Frozen test-only pre-port selector oracle; byte-verified against the owned baseline artifact and excluded from the production-source denominator.

classifications.rust-native: Rust native runtime owner; status distinguishes active ownership from pending source migration.
classifications.rust-wasm: Rust/WASM portable-policy owner; status distinguishes active ownership from pending source migration.
classifications.contract: Declarative or generated contract/build input, exported rather than hand-mirrored.
classifications.build-tooling: Build, registration, diagnostics, or distribution tooling.

statuses.pending: A concrete JavaScript portable-policy boundary remains. A mixed entry lists its policy symbols and host callsites; an unmixed pending entry is a whole-file policy owner, never host glue.
statuses.retained: The current JavaScript/shell implementation is intentionally retained as a browser, third-party, or tooling boundary.
statuses.contract-source: The current declarative source remains authoritative and is exported/generated for consumers instead of ported as runtime policy.
statuses.active: The declared Rust owner governs the listed live policy symbols. This records source ownership only; it does not assert installed activation, release status, or browser E2E certification.

excludedFromProductionInventory.reason: Tests and license notices are intentionally outside the production-source denominator; all other regular files under sourceRoots are explicitly enumerated below.

coverageAlgorithm.discover: Recursively enumerate regular files below each sourceRoots entry, normalize paths to repository-relative POSIX form, then remove only excludedFromProductionInventory entries.
coverageAlgorithm.compare: Fail if the discovered path set differs from files[].path: report unclassified discovered paths, stale inventory paths, and duplicate entries separately.
coverageAlgorithm.validate: Fail if an entry lacks classification, status, plannedOwner, or rationale; permit only classification-compatible statuses; require Rust-owner, Rust-symbol, host-responsibility, and live-caller provenance for active Rust entries; for mixed entries, verify every reachableCallsites path remains in the discovered production set.
coverageAlgorithm.policy: Do not infer a classification from an unlisted directory or filename at coverage time. This file is the exhaustive, path-by-path classification authority.
